changelogs:
20260923
「Both Maps 」
Boss and Mob - Added 'Cacophony State' enemies. These enemies will disappear during Cacophony Zones and some of them replaced with a Phantom Ulidim
Boss and Mob Upgrade/Downgrade States - Thanks to feedback from various people, updated multiple Boss and Mobs to reflect their ability to be upgraded to an elite or vice versa, big thanks to everyone!

20260922

NEW MAPS - added Boss, Elites and Mobs maps to help with High-Risk Hematite Shard farming route!

「Janus Illusion」
Strongbox - 2 new Electronic Strongboxes at the junction between Construction Site and Station and at the far north spawn point
Briefcase - Added new Random Briefcases. Depending on where you spawn on the map, the fake briefcases can turn real. Big thanks to u/Amasoken for mapping them!
「Both Maps 」
Map Update - Improved visual clarity for Aerial Railway Tracks

20260914
「Janus Illusion」
Fake and real briefcases are separated (only real briefcases drop Break-Even Beacon)
Doppel Jane Construction Site location correction
Briefcase Construction Site floor correction
「Suburbs Illusion」
All briefcases on this map are real
20260904「Suburbs Illusion」
Strongbox - 3 New Random Electronic Strongbox at the West Spawn area, Room before Billy Lift and Romeul's Area near the Medic Station
Briefcase - 1 New Briefcase at the far north of Bunless Bae Town, near Cheezburg Bistro ( thanks u/Amasoken! )
「Janus Illusion」
Strongbox - 1 New Random Electronic Strongbox at 3rd Floor Construction Site near Jane Doe spawn, tucked with the Briefcase.

20260901
「Janus Illusion」
Strongbox Update - Found 2 new random Electronic Strongboxes. One at the far North Spawn and one below the basketball court near Random Play.
「Suburbs Illusion」
Briefcase Update - Found a new Briefcase at the gated room before entering Billy Lift.
Strongbox Update - Found 3 new random Electronic Strongboxes at gated room before Billy Lift and one before Windworn Motel.
「Both Maps 」
Map Update - Added Aerial Railway Tracks for better visual clarity when planning routes  ( thanks PhoenixTofu for idea! )
- Access Cards are now persistently displayed in all maps.

20260827
「 Janus Illusion 」
Briefcase Update - Added 3 new Briefcases at Construction Site boss spawn next to 2nd floor Gear Box, east near train station player spawn and north east location.  
「 Suburb Illusion 」
Briefcase Update - Added 1 new Briefcase at the transition area between Bahamut Warehouse and the open area guarded by a boss before Fantasy Beach. Added Briefcase for Cheezburg Bistro Access Card Room with a key icon indicating Access Card required.

Thanks u/Amasoken for finding them!

20260825 -
「 Janus Illusion 」
Strongbox Update - Found new Strongboxes at room behind a shutter door to the right side of Random Play. Appears randomly.
Access Card Update - Fixed a mistake where Mechanical Strongbox vs Electronic Strongbox numbers for 6th Street are wrong.
Add Connecting Portals

「 Suburb Illusion 」
Access Card Update - Added Briefcase among the loots at Cheezburg Bistro
Strongbox Update - Found new Electronic Strongbox at Gas Station. Rare Random Appearance.
Add Connecting Portals

20260822 - Edited Access Card Room Locations to include the number of Strongboxes inside them
summary: 2026-09-23：两图标注会在喧响区消失、部分可能被 Phantom Ulidim 替代的敌人，并更新可升降级标记。
2026-09-22：增加 BOSS、精英与小怪专图；雅努斯新增两个随机电子保险箱及随出生位置变化真假的公文包；改进空中轨道显示。
limitations: 沿用作者图例。非问号图标不等于多局验证的必刷点。
图标中心为图像位置；不代表游戏世界坐标或精确交互位置。
精英与小怪共用图例，未擅自细分；升降级和喧响状态影响敌人与掉落。
新增资料独立编号 9—22，原资料 1—8 与既有标记编号保持可追溯。
